messages:
Ravi Shah: impulse thread — mini idea: a turntable bookclub. 1 record + 1 short book/essay under 200 pages. weekend listening+reading, then share one-liners Monday? Ill kick off: Stereolab — Emperor Tomato Ketchup + Teju Cole — Known and Strange Things (pick the essay).
Maggie O: love this. my pick: Laura Nyro — New York Tendaberry + Ottessa Moshfegh — McGlue (short, punchy).
Owen Park: @Ravi this rules. my pair: Captain Beefheart — Trout Mask Replica + Clarice Lispector — The Hour of the Star. chaotic, in a good way.
Clara Hu: putting my vote in: Nineteen Eighty-Four on vinyl? kidding. real rec: Joni Mitchell — For the Roses + Rachel Cusk — Transit (short & luminous).
Eve (turntable-bot): playlist_generated: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5exampleseed (shared from picks). Use `!add <track>` to add.
Ravi Shah: quick mechanic idea: react with :white_check_mark: if youre in, add your pair as a reply. polls later if many people.
Maggie O: :white_check_mark: Im in. will drop a track list tomorrow.
Owen Park: :white_check_mark: shifting my weekend schedule already.
Clara Hu: :white_check_mark: will try to find a secondhand copy of Trout Mask Replica for authenticity points.
Eve (turntable-bot): note: listening session suggestion: Saturday 7pm PT, 45 minutes of tracks then a 20-minute chat. RSVP with :hand: to save a spot.
Ravi Shah: @everyone quick strawpoll: Saturday 7pm PT works? react :one: for yes, :two: for no.
Maggie O: :one:
Owen Park: :one:
Clara Hu: :one:
Ravi Shah: nice. will post an event thread and a shared collaborative playlist link tomorrow. cheers and sleep well :crescent_moon:
Eve (turntable-bot): event_created: turntable-bookclub-199123 (participants_opt_in: 3)
